quiz.question: Who turns out to be the last surviving robber in the opening bank heist?
quiz.explanation: The Joker reveals himself as the mastermind after the other robbers betray and kill one another.

quiz.question: Why does Bruce publicly support Harvey Dent as Gotham’s protector?
options: He hopes Dent’s success will let him retire as Batman
He wants Dent to run Wayne Enterprises
He plans to make Dent the next police commissioner
He believes Dent already knows his identity
quiz.explanation: Bruce sees Dent as a legitimate protector whose success could let him stop being Batman.
evidence_markers: allow him to retire as Batman

quiz.question: Where does Batman travel to bring the mob’s accountant Lau back to Gotham?
quiz.explanation: Lau flees to Hong Kong, where Batman finds him and returns him to Gotham police custody.
evidence_markers: Batman finds Lau in Hong Kong

quiz.question: What price does the Joker name for killing Batman at the mob meeting?
options: Half of the mob’s hidden fortune
quiz.explanation: The Joker offers to kill Batman in exchange for half of the fortune concealed by Lau.
evidence_markers: offers to kill Batman for half of the fortune

quiz.question: Why does Harvey Dent claim that he is Batman?
options: To stop Gordon from becoming commissioner
To take control of Wayne Enterprises
quiz.explanation: Dent uses the false claim to draw out the Joker, who then attacks the convoy transporting him.
evidence_markers: Dent claims he is Batman to lure the Joker out

quiz.question: Batman races to save Rachel but reaches Dent instead. What caused the switch?
options: The Joker gave their locations in reverse
quiz.explanation: The Joker reverses the two locations, so Batman’s attempt to reach Rachel leads him to Dent.

quiz.question: After Rachel’s death, what does Dent use to decide his victims’ fates?
quiz.explanation: Dent leaves his decisions to the coin, now scarred on one side.

quiz.question: How do the passengers on the two rigged ferries respond to the Joker’s ultimatum?
options: The civilians destroy the prisoners’ ferry
Both groups refuse to kill the other
The prisoners destroy the civilians’ ferry
quiz.explanation: Neither group kills the other, defying the Joker’s expectation.
evidence_markers: passengers refuse to kill one another

quiz.question: Why does Batman accept blame for Dent’s death and crimes?
options: To protect the Joker from prosecution
To preserve Dent as the hero Gotham needs
quiz.explanation: Batman and Gordon conceal Dent’s corruption to preserve Gotham’s faith in him.
evidence_markers: Dent is the hero the city needs

quiz.question: What happens to the surveillance network after it helps Batman locate the Joker?
options: Gordon transfers it to the police
Bruce sells it to the city
The Joker takes control of it
quiz.explanation: Fox destroys the invasive surveillance network once it has helped Batman find the Joker.
evidence_markers: Fox destroys the invasive surveillance network

facts.title: Rory’s First Kiss
facts.text: The Chicago shoot used Rory’s First Kiss as a cover title. The press quickly worked out which film was really being made.

facts.title: An IMAX experiment at the post office
facts.text: The bank heist was shot first at Chicago’s old main post office. It tested the IMAX process early enough to allow a reshoot with conventional cameras.

facts.title: A motorcycle built for one rider
facts.text: The Batpod was so unwieldy that stunt rider Jean Pierre Goy was the only person able to ride it, after months of training.
evidence_markers: could only be ridden by stuntman Jean Pierre Goy

facts.title: Makeup that moved with Ledger
facts.text: Ledger scrunched his face while the Joker’s makeup was applied. Relaxing his expression created the cracks and uneven texture.

facts.title: A score divided by character
facts.text: James Newton Howard focused on Harvey Dent’s music, while Hans Zimmer worked on Batman and the Joker.
evidence_markers: Zimmer focused on Batman and the Joker
